name: Paprika
tagline: Recipes, meal plans and grocery lists in Paprika
description: Search your recipes in Paprika Recipe Manager and check your meal plan and grocery list. You can also save new recipes with photos after a preview. The tool connects through Paprika’s cloud sync and builds on Matt Russell’s Paprika CLI.
examples: What's on the meal plan this week?

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Show whether credentials are configured and for which account

tools.name: list_recipes
tools.description: List recipes not in the trash, optionally filtered by category name

tools.name: search_recipes
tools.description: Search recipes by name or description

tools.name: get_recipe
tools.description: Get one recipe by UID or name, optionally ingredients only

tools.name: list_meals
tools.description: Show the meal plan, optionally for one date

tools.name: list_groceries
tools.description: Show the grocery list, optionally including purchased items

tools.name: create_recipe
tools.description: Create a recipe (preview unless confirm=true), optionally with a photo

tools.name: update_recipe
tools.description: Replace an existing recipe's fields (preview unless confirm=true)

envVars.name: PAPRIKA_EMAIL
envVars.description: Paprika account email (with PAPRIKA_PASSWORD, overrides the config file)

envVars.name: PAPRIKA_MCP_ENABLE_WRITES
envVars.description: Set to 1 to expose create_recipe and update_recipe in the MCP server

envVars.name: XDG_CONFIG_HOME
envVars.description: Base directory for the config file (default ~/.config)

is.tagline: Uppskriftir, mataráætlanir og innkaupalistar í Paprika
is.description: Leitaðu í uppskriftunum þínum í Paprika Recipe Manager og skoðaðu mataráætlunina og innkaupalistann. Þú getur líka vistað nýjar uppskriftir með mynd eftir forskoðun. Tólið tengist Paprika í gegnum skýjasamstillingu og byggir á Paprika CLI eftir Matt Russell.
examples: Hvað er á mataráætluninni í vikunni?
